requirements: Fresh exclusive startup: require all three ADC gate bits and TIM2 gate initially zero; reject an existing owner instead of resetting it.
Enable ADC1EN and TIM2EN preserving unrelated gates; read back each gate before peripheral accesses. Keep ADC2/ADC3 gates zero.

RM0090 Rev22 p250 repeats disabled for ADC1EN=0 and =1. Resolve the typo using the acquired exact-hash ST HAL enable macro SET_BIT and disable macro bit-clear; retain both sources as an explicit reviewed resolution.
adc_timer_gates.title: ADC1 and TIM2 owned startup gates

requirements: Start with CAN1 and CAN2 clocks disabled and exclusive ownership of both controllers/shared filters. Do not reset another owner.
Enable/read back CAN1EN, assert/release CAN1RST, preserve unrelated bits and leave CAN2EN disabled.
Use the declared reviewed PCLK1=42MHz recipe. Clock Boolean and source retrieval do not prove hardware state.
can1_gate_reset.title: Exclusive CAN1 reset and shared-filter ownership

requirements: Enable GPIODEN and read it back before GPIO accesses; preserve every unrelated AHB1 gate. This route changes no peripheral reset or CAN2 state.
can1_rx_gpio_gate.title: Owned GPIOD bus gate for CAN1 RX candidate

requirements: Own both DAC channels before asserting reset; no live reconfiguration or reset of an existing owner.
Enable DACEN and read it back, assert then release DACRST, preserving unrelated APB1 bits.
Use the reviewed HSE8/SYSCLK168/PCLK1=42MHz clock recipe; a software Boolean alone does not prove ownership, reset or electrical readiness.
dac_gate_reset.title: Owned DAC block gate/reset at the declared clock point

requirements: Owned cold startup: require HSION=HSIRDY=1, SW=SWS=HSI, AHB/APB divisors1, and SystemCoreClock updated to16000000.
This mode checks existing state; it does not switch a running clock or rewrite FLASH/PWR. Reject mismatches before starting SysTick.
HSI16 is nominal RC timing, not a physical measurement. SysTick uses HCLK directly and needs no APB peripheral gate.
hsi16_core_checked.title: Read-only validation of nominal HSI16 core clock

requirements: Exclusive I2C1 owner at owned startup; establish the required PLL clock recipe before access.
Enable I2C1EN, read back, pulse I2C1RST then release; preserve all unrelated/reserved RCC bits. Never reset an active bus owner.
No GPIO routing, pull-up or external target qualification is asserted by gate/reset.
i2c1_gate_reset.title: I2C1 APB1 gate and owned-startup reset

requirements: Enable the target peripheral clock before accessing its registers.
Preserve unrelated and reserved bits.
A bus gate is distinct from a valid source clock; the reference PLL plan is not proof of a running clock configuration.
peripheral_clock_gates.title: CRC/DMA/SPI/RNG peripheral clock gates

requirements: Assume HSE8 crystal, internal regulator,2.7-3.6V and exclusive startup ownership; no measured clock or errata certification.
Do not reconfigure an active PLLI2S/CSS or live peripheral owner. Enable/wait HSI, select it and confirm SWS before disabling main PLL.
Install safe APB1/4 and APB2/2 divisors; disable PLL and wait unlocked; disable HSE and confirm not ready before clearing HSEBYP.
Enable/read back PWR gate, establish Scale1/VOSRDY and set/read back FLASH LATENCY5 before increasing HCLK.
Enable/wait HSE; with both PLLs disabled program M8/N336/P2/Q7,HSE source while preserving reserved fields; enable PLL and wait lock.
Select PLL, confirm SWS and divisors, then synchronize SystemCoreClock. Every wait finite; failure stops dependent initialization without claiming a successful clock switch.
pll_hse8_168mhz.title: Owned startup: HSE8 crystal to SYSCLK168/PCLK1=42/PCLK2=84/PLL48=48MHz

requirements: Set PWREN, preserving other gate configuration, then read the enable register before PWR access.
power_interface_gate.title: Enable and read back the PWR APB1 gate

requirements: Privileged exclusive startup, no TIM2 owner or downstream TRGO consumers; keep TIM1EN=0.
Require TIM2EN=0/TIM2RST=0 initially; enable/read back gate, assert/read back reset, release/read back; preserve unrelated bits.
No live clock changes; failures block timer setup.
tim2_owned_gate_reset.title: Owned TIM2 startup gate/reset with TIM1 inactive

requirements: Exclusive fresh TIM2, no channel/slave/interrupt/DMA owners, declared HSE8 PLL mode and APB1/4; TIM2CLK=2*PCLK1=84 MHz.
Keep CEN=0 and DIER=0 while setting PSC=8399, ARR=9. Write EGR=UG to load PSC/reinitialize counter; write SR=0 afterward to discard the UG-created UIF.
Set CR1=OPM|CEN with UDIS/URS/DIR/CMS/ARPE zero. Poll UIF with a finite budget and verify CEN cleared. This is 1 ms nominal under the declared clock assumptions, not measured timing.
Do not accept the stale UG flag as elapsed time. Stop the owned timer on failure. This operation uses no timer output pin or NVIC interrupt.
polling_update_delay.title: Owned TIM2 one-pulse polling delay at TIM2CLK=84 MHz

requirements: Fresh privileged owned startup, PRIMASK=1, no downstream TRGO consumers; TIM1 stays gated.
Checked nominal HSI16/APB1 divisor1; PSC<=65535, period2..UINT32_MAX counts, high0..period.
CC1S=CC2S=0, OC1M=110, OC1PE=1, ARPE=1; all CCER enables and DIER requests remain0.
Configure while CEN=0; verify CCMR1 direction before CCR1 write; UG transfers preloads, clear stale SR, verify, enable CEN last.
CCR1 readback is preload only; wait for a fresh bounded UIF event for update evidence; no compare-event guarantee.
No GPIO/pin waveform, advanced/center/toggle modes, DMA or IRQ support is implied; failure/cleanup never permits automatic retry.
pwm_ch1_reference.title: TIM2 internal PWM1 channel1 reference; physical output disabled

requirements: Fresh privileged owned startup, PRIMASK=1, no downstream TRGO consumers; TIM1 gate remains0.
CC1S=11, TS=000 selects TIM1_TRGO/ITR0; SMS=0/ECE=0; IC1PSC=0, IC1F=0, CC1P=CC1NP=0.
Keep CEN=0, ARR=0xFFFFFFFF, DIER=0; enable CC1E only after UG, stale clearing and validated setup.
Refuse pending CC1IF/CC1OF before issuing an event; write/read back stopped CNT, then action-write EGR.CC1G.
Bound polling; read CCR1 before final SR overcapture/new-event check; reject stale, missing, overcaptured or mismatching data.
Never write CCR1 in input mode. No external pin, elapsed-time, filter or edge measurement is qualified.
